title: Filtering the products table by text · part 2

steps.title: Search with LIKE for names starting 'Dri'
steps.prompt:
LIKE searches by pattern using the % wildcard.
Dri% means 'starts with'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE 'Dri%';
hints: Write: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE 'Dri%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE 'Dri%';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for 'rie' anywhere
steps.prompt:
Putting % on BOTH sides matches the text anywhere.
This %rie% means 'contains'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%rie%';
hints: Wrap the text in %% on both sides.
Write: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%rie%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%rie%';

steps.title: Keep rows where name is Fez Tarouch Caftan
steps.prompt:
WHERE is a sieve: only rows that pass the test stay.

steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name = 'Fez Tarouch Caftan';

steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name = 'Fez Tarouch Caftan';
